title: Train, validation and test
text: Training data fit model parameters. Validation data guide choices such as depth or learning rate. Use the held-out test set after those choices are finished.

title: Scaling without leakage
text: Fit a scaler on training features only. Apply that fitted transformation to validation and test features. Fitting on all rows leaks information about the held-out data.

title: Recall and precision
text: Recall is TP divided by TP plus FN: the fraction of actual positive cases detected. Precision is TP divided by TP plus FP: the fraction of positive predictions that are correct.

title: Random Forest
text: Random Forest combines decision trees trained with variation in sampled rows and candidate features. Compare its predictions against other models using the same held-out rows and target.

title: CNN and image shape
text: A grayscale Fashion-MNIST image has 28 rows, 28 columns and one channel. Convolution applies shared local filters. Pooling reduces spatial dimensions; flattening rearranges values.

title: Attention and Transformers
text: A query is compared with keys to obtain attention scores. Softmax converts scaled scores into weights. A weighted combination of values forms the attention output. A Transformer also includes feed-forward layers, residual connections and normalisation.

title: Regression and classification
text: Regression predicts a numerical amount, such as fuel consumption. Classification predicts a category, such as a clothing label. Mean squared error evaluates squared numerical errors; a confusion matrix counts classification outcomes.

title: Generated-answer limitations
text: Check generated claims against source evidence. A citation identifier can be valid while the linked passage does not support the claim. Retrieved material supplies context and does not by itself update the model weights.
